name: ptcg-mobile
description: PTCG 简中对战：安卓客户端与对战服务

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:service && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:service && node scripts/e2e-handshake.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:rooms: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:service && node scripts/e2e-rooms.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:opening: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:service && node scripts/e2e-opening.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:turn: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:service && node scripts/e2e-turn.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npm run android:sync -w @ptcg/client
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:sync && npm run android:apk:debug -w @ptcg/client
